recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-33129 unless a future work group decision reopens the broader BodyStructure model or the cross-version migration notes.
issue_request: FHIR-33129 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for R5 asking to eliminate BodyStructure.location and BodyStructure.locationQualifier and replace them with includedStructure 1..* and excludedStructure 0..* backbone elements. Each backbone was to include structure 1..1, laterality 0..1, and qualifier 0..*.
initial_application: The request was applied before this reconciliation. Commit a67549d981 added includedStructure and excludedStructure and updated examples from location/locationQualifier to structure, laterality, and qualifier. Jira records 3b71a9e220 as an applied build correction, and follow-up PR #1564 commits 2be93943a1 and 0d176cd4f removed the remaining top-level location element and obsolete BodyStructure-location search parameter.
additional_context: BodyStructure is active in source/fhir.ini. Current StructureDefinition source has includedStructure 1..*, includedStructure.structure 1..1, laterality 0..1, qualifier 0..*, and excludedStructure 0..* by content reference. Current examples and search parameters use the included/excluded model. The only remaining BodyStructure.location and BodyStructure.locationQualifier strings found are R4-to-R6 migration notes in fhir.ini. OO WGM minutes from 2021-09-20 record the Body Structure proposal and 15-0-6 motion. Later BodyStructure issues, including FHIR-38646, refined narrative around this model without reversing it.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative StructureDefinition, examples, and search parameter bundle already carry the approved FHIR-33129 restructuring, and old element names only remain as appropriate cross-version migration metadata.
